shamon harage.bio: Scarborough MC Rishaard, also credited as Shamon Harage, is a member of the long-running Canadian hip-hop collective Monolith. His recorded work includes appearances alongside Dan-e-o, Wio-K, Grimace Love and other Monolith members on records including The Book of Daniel, In Real Life and Perception.

spidahman.bio: Scarborough rapper Spidahman is a veteran member of Toronto’s Monolith collective whose forceful, battle-ready delivery appears across the crew’s late-1990s and 2000s catalogue. His credits include Monolith’s The Long Awaited..., Dan-e-o records such as Raw Is War and The Real Deal, and Wio-K’s posse cut Ten.

spidah man.bio: Scarborough rapper Spidahman, whose name is also styled Spidah Man, is a veteran member of Toronto’s Monolith collective. His recordings span Monolith’s The Long Awaited... and collaborations with fellow members including Dan-e-o, Wio-K and Grimace Love.

parker.bio: Scarborough MC Parker is a member of Monolith, the Canadian hip-hop collective formed in Toronto in the mid-1990s. He appears with the crew on recordings including Wio-K’s Ten and Grimace Love’s Perception-era material, part of the interconnected catalogue that made Monolith a fixture of Toronto underground rap.
